name: Tamara Caswell
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: As we grow and change in life we might find ourselves faced with many different challenges, sometimes due to family history, social and cultural conditioning, religious beliefs, and gender-based beliefs, roles, and biases. We might realise that our sexual identity and preferences might be different from what we were taught to believe and as a result, we struggle within ourselves to accept who we are and are unable to live authentically. I work with individuals and couples to navigate the unique challenges faced by those wanting to explore different relationship styles other than the standard heterosexual monogamous relationship, such as Kink, BDSM, swinging, consensual nonmonogamy, or polyamory, especially those in mixed-orientation and queer relationships. I am a non-judgemental, accepting, safe, person-centered trauma-informed therapist who is there to support you through those challenging times that you might be facing either alone or as a couple.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery
